hooks.command: MAIN_REPO=$(git worktree list --porcelain | head -1 | sed 's/^worktree //') && WORKTREE_DIR=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && [ "$MAIN_REPO" != "$WORKTREE_DIR" ] && bash "$MAIN_REPO/scripts/worktree/setup.sh" || true
f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/*) npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
